text: The cache/offline pump and server article completion callbacks clear the channel's retained listener after notifying it, then mark the channel no longer pending. The listener can own a MIME converter or memory-cache tee. These are normal-path releases: preceding callbacks and state/commit operations are not enclosed by finally, so the assignments do not prove exception or cancellation cleanup. The owned landing also clears an expired-article completion path that is absent from the later accepted file.
title: The NNTP channel clears its retained listener after normal completion callbacks
